title: Rule-level first observable NULL-semantics boundary change in instrumented Spark
baseline: RuleExecutor.scala existing QueryProofAstTrace.capture serializes pre/post Catalyst JSON per effective rule
primary_hypothesis: Historical B01/B02/B03 errors can be associated with a specific RuleExecutor transition that changes a syntactic null-observable expression representation; matched analyzed context demand (FALSE_ONLY, NULL_ONLY, FULL_3VL) must be preserved to prove unsoundness.
no_claim: A structural event alone cannot prove unsoundness; forced ablation that restores correctness is causal evidence, not an unconditional proof. Positive detection counts only independent 3VL or row bag oracle, not rule ranking.
snapshot_scope: Only instrumented disposable official PySpark 4.2.0 JAR; no upstream source modifications
predeclared_readouts: effective rule event counts per query
rule sequence first loss of Or inside Not and first InSubquery removal
all before/after AST target counts and contextual ancestor paths
candidate rule ranked without access to oracle expected answers
capture full AST event JSON outside GitHub Actions logs
errors and unsupported event sizes without silent discards
stage2: After candidate selection, run one-rule-at-a-time interventions by excluding or forced skipping only selected candidates, verify against held-out expected results in separate scorer, no unreported tuning.
limits: Original 3 historical failures are in-sample; no new discovery claim
Plan JSON may hide subquery expression contexts and rules in analyzer not optimizer; report gaps
Do not assume any first structural mutation is semantic root cause
Small sample; runtime overhead and user data privacy (synthetic only)
success: Automatically enumerate provenance candidate(s) for each of 3 known issues and correctly distinguish negative controls without manually hardcoding rule names. If not, record explicit no localization.
